title: GitHub main branch online updates
description: Check the latest commit on GitHub main and prepare its source archive. With the server runner configured, back up, install, migrate, restart and track health checks here. No separate signed update attachment is required.
no_staged_packages: No verified update package is currently staged.
stage_success: The GitHub main source archive was downloaded, integrity-checked and placed in private staging.
stage_boundary: Downloading and preparing a candidate does not install it. Installation still requires backups, migrations, health checks and a service restart.
prepare_success: The Release source was prepared as a private candidate and passed release manifest, migration and PHP syntax checks. Nothing was installed.
install_starting: Creating a backup and starting the installation task…
install_complete: The update was installed and the health check passed.
install_failed: The update failed. Review the server task log and backup before retrying.
